usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/exa/find-similar with JSON body {url, numResults?, excludeSourceDomain?}
usage.outputShape: body.results[].url and body.results[].title (title may be empty string for some results); body.results[].score (similarity 0-1); body.results[].author when available; body.costDollars.total for actual cost; body.requestId
quirks: Required field is `url` (the source page to find similar pages to), not `query` — this is find-similar, not search
Some results return title:"" and author:null even on success; only url and score are reliably populated
excludeSourceDomain defaults to true (won't return pages from the same domain as the source url)
numResults default 10; schema allows up to 100 but x402 tier may cap lower
Provider-reported costDollars.total ($0.007) is less than the x402 quote charged ($0.010)
usage.guide: POST to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/exa/find-similar with a JSON body containing at minimum {"url": "<source page url>"}. Optionally pass numResults (default 10) and excludeSourceDomain (default true). Payment of $0.01 USDC is charged per call on Base via x402 — no API key needed. Results return synchronously in body.results[], each with url, score (similarity), and optionally title/author. Read body.results[].url for the similar pages, sorted by descending score.
